# Digital Manufacturing Experts


## Experienced industry leaders and specialists are available to discuss prototyping and production with digital manufacturing


## Suresh Krishna


###### CEO and President


Krishna is President and Chief Executive Officer of Protolabs. He previously served as the President and Chief Executive Officer of Northern Tool + Equipment. Krishna has also held operations and leadership roles at companies such as Sleep Number Corporation, Polaris Industries and UTC Fire & Security. He holds a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from the National Institute of Technology (Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India) and a Master of Business Administration from the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Evolution of digital manufacturing to serve customers from prototyping to production
- Leadership strategies that drive growth and remove friction across organizations
- Establishment of customer-centric culture


---


## Marc Kermisch


###### Chief Technology and Artificial Intelligence Officer


Kermish oversees Protolabs’ global technology organization, leading its strategic initiatives and artificial intelligence (AI) strategy. Kermisch brings more than 25 years of senior executive experience at technology and R&D organizations across diverse industries, including manufacturing, software, and retail. Most recently, he served as Chief Technology Officer for Emergent Software, a technology company specializing in software development, cloud transformation, AI, and data engineering solutions. Prior to Emergent, he was Global Chief Digital and Information Officer at Case New Holland (NYSE: CNH), a manufacturer of agriculture and construction equipment where he focused on developing autonomous vehicles, precision farming applications, and electric powertrains.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Implementation of AI strategies on an enterprise level
- Technological transformation within manufacturing
- Industry 5.0 strategies pairing automation and technology with human expertise


---


## Pjotr Horowitz


###### Vice President EMEA, Sales & Customer Success


Horowitz is vice president of sales and customer success in the EMEA region, bringing more than 20 years of senior executive experience to Protolabs. He was previously managing director of Protolabs Network, formerly known as Hubs, and led the organization through its post-acquisition integration with Protolabs. His experience also includes leadership roles in logistics, supply chain management and technology, including Chief Operating Officer of Ontruck in Madrid, and commercial director of C.H. Robinson Europe.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Manufacturing industry and supply chain trends and insights across EMEA
- European customer requirements, and Protolabs' strategies to support them
- The combined strength of Protolabs' in-house factories and global network


---


## Andrea Landoni


###### Global Product Manager


Landoni has been working at Protolabs for over seven years, specializing in product management for 3D printing. Prior to this, he spent eight years in the automotive industry, gaining expertise in product management, account management, and strategic planning. Landoni holds a Master of Industrial Engineering and has extensive knowledge of European markets, having worked and lived in three different countries.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Current and future-looking trends within 3D printing
- Emerging 3D-printing trends within industries
- Protolabs' strategies to support companies across different countries throughout their development cycles


---


## Samuel Guest


###### Global Product Manager


Guest supports the evolution of Protolabs’ digital manufacturing capabilities by leading cross-functional initiatives across product, engineering, operations, and go‑to‑market teams. With a background in product strategy, commercial execution, and manufacturing innovation, his insights enhance customer experience. He works in close collaboration with leaders across the company to translate market data into plans that best meet the needs of customers across EMEA.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Current and future-looking trends across digital manufacturing, including automation, AI-enabled production, and advanced materials
- Market intelligence shaping the evolution of Protolabs' product lines
- Protolabs' strategies to deliver customer value


---


## Robert Musselle


###### Director of Customer Engineering, EMEA


Musselle is Protolabs’ director of customer engineering for EMEA, leading a team that delivers world‑class digital manufacturing expertise. With over 18 years at Protolabs, he has deep knowledge of injection molding, CNC machining, and 3D printing, supporting customers from early concept development through to production. His background spans design, quality control, post‑sales support, and application engineering, with a strong foundation in product optimization and scalable manufacturing. He holds a Master of Art & Design from the University of Wolverhampton, focusing on product design and manufacturing processes.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Digital manufacturing throughout the product life cycle
- Optimizing products for manufacturability
- Customer engineering leadership & technical guidance


---


## Eric Utley


###### 3D Printing Applications Engineering Manager


Utley is an applications engineering manager at Protolabs with over 16 years of experience in additive manufacturing and has manufactured products for the medical, consumer products, aerospace, and automotive industries. A passionate evangelical of digital manufacturing methods, Utley has published industry thought leadership for Design News, Machine Design, and 3DPrint.com. Today, he manages an applications engineering team of both 3D printing and CNC machining manufacturing experts. He earned a bachelor’s degree from North Carolina State University.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Emerging 3D printing applications within or across industries
- Evolution of 3D printing technologies
- Designing parts for 3D printing


---


## Chloe Vollaro


###### 3D Printing Project Engineer


Vollaro is a project engineer at Protolabs with nearly a decade of experience in additive manufacturing. She specializes in helping customers leverage additive manufacturing for production and high requirement projects. She has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut and is pursuing a Master of Materials Science and Engineering degree from North Carolina State University.


#### Areas of Expertise


- 3D printing material advancement and resulting expanded applications
- Leveraging 3D printing for end-use production parts
- Applications for 3D printing across emerging technologies


---


## Teresa Rock


###### Software Engineering Manager


Software engineering manager, Dr. Teresa Rock specializes in machine learning, generative AI, and applied research. She brings extensive experience in digital transformation and enterprise‑scale AI adoption to Protolabs, where she leads the company’s AI COE including strategic transformation, solution delivery, and engineering capabilities. Before joining Protolabs, she held roles in companies including BMW Group, driving organization‑wide AI initiatives and shaping long‑term technology roadmaps. Rock holds a PhD in engineering and computer science from the Technical University of Berlin.


#### Areas of Expertise


- Enterprise-wide AI strategy, digital transformation, and change management
- Building end-to-end AI, machine learning, and GenAI solutions across industries
- Leading high-performing engineering teams and shaping product roadmaps


---
